ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - LaZagne Execution
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the execution of the LaZagne. A utility used to retrieve multiple types of passwords stored on a local computer.
LaZagne has been leveraged multiple times by threat actors in order to dump credentials.

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\lazagne\\\.exe$") OR ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Tmp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\\\$Recycle\\\.bin.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Links\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Music\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Photos\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Pictures\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Saved\\ Games\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Searches\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Contacts\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Default\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Searches\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Videos\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\addins\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Fonts\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\IME\\\\.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\ all$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\ browsers$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\ chats$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\ databases$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\ games$") OR process_command_line = process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\ windows$"))) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*all\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*browsers\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*chats\\ .*") OR
